physics_cannon_master.png.priority: Preferred cannon and thermal block match latest first-world physical-device screenshot. Ice intact/cracked from terrain atlas; jet from this or previous physics atlas.

limitations: Raw masters are not pixel-perfect exports. Actual dimensions differ from requested. Rectangles and alpha measurements are source-pixel measurements, not a claim of 32px output.

Normalize by nearest sampling with stable animation foot anchors. Preserve death alpha; do not use one global threshold. Sprite registration, seams, palette cleanup and in-game visual QA remain integration work.
Visuals must not alter RoomLab 2.5.5 colliders or original level JSON.
No source has editable PSD layers. No background seamlessness has been established.
